description: Tier 2 routing evaluations — tests TF-IDF skill routing precision against realistic user prompts drawn from common engineering, product, design, and strategy scenarios.

suites.description: Core development routing: backend, frontend, fullstack, API, database

scenarios.input: Build me a REST API with FastAPI for user authentication with JWT tokens
Create a React dashboard with Tailwind CSS, dark mode, and responsive charts
Build a fullstack Next.js app with server actions, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL
Design a normalized database schema for a multi-tenant SaaS platform
Design a GraphQL API with proper error handling, pagination, and versioning strategy
Build a cross-platform mobile app with offline sync and push notifications
Create an iOS app with SwiftUI, Core Data, and WidgetKit extensions
Build an Android app using Jetpack Compose with Room database and WorkManager

suites.description: DevOps and infrastructure routing: CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, SRE, cloud

scenarios.input: Set up a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, Docker builds, and staging deployment
Containerize microservices and deploy to Kubernetes with Helm charts and ingress
Set up observability: metrics, logging, traces with OpenTelemetry and Grafana dashboards
Define SLOs, error budgets, and on-call runbooks for a production payment service
Architect a multi-region AWS deployment with VPC, RDS, Lambda, and CloudFront
Build a real-time market data ingestion pipeline with order book normalization

suites.description: Quality and security routing: code review, testing, security audit, vulnerability

scenarios.input: Review this pull request for bugs, logic errors, and maintainability issues
Audit this authentication flow for OWASP vulnerabilities and token handling flaws
Write unit tests for a payment processing service following TDD principles
Create an end-to-end test suite with Cypress for the checkout flow
Debug a production crash in Node.js — heap out of memory, need root cause analysis
Refactor this overly complex function — reduce cognitive complexity from 25 to under 10

suites.description: Product, strategy, and business routing: PRD, roadmap, strategy, funding

scenarios.input: Write a PRD for a mobile payment feature with RICE prioritization and acceptance criteria
Transform this rough product idea into a structured engineering specification with data models
Prepare a Series A pitch deck, financial model, and cap table for investors
Evaluate build-vs-buy for our authentication system — Okta vs custom implementation
Design a B2B SaaS pricing model with tiered plans, usage-based billing, and annual contracts
Design a microservices architecture for an event-driven e-commerce platform at scale
Plan a zero-downtime canary deployment with feature flags and automated rollback

suites.description: Design and UX routing: design systems, accessibility, brand, UI patterns

scenarios.input: Build a design system with design tokens, component library, and Figma handoff specs
Design a complete brand identity: logo, color palette, typography, and brand guidelines
Audit our web app for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance with screen reader testing
Run user interviews, create personas, and map customer journeys for a healthcare app
Design a trading dashboard UI with real-time order book, candlestick charts, and P&L widgets
Design a HUD and menu system for an FPS game with cross-platform controller support

suites.description: Meta-routing: disambiguation between closely related skills

scenarios.input: Look at this code for potential issues
Help me plan the next sprint and prioritize the backlog
Set up infrastructure for deploying microservices to production
Build a marketing landing page with CMS integration and SEO optimization
Model cash flow projections and runway for the next 24 months
Build a recommendation system with collaborative filtering and A/B test its impact

suites.description: Negative routing: tasks that should NOT route to certain skills (Do NOT use for... enforcement)

scenarios.input: Give me feedback on this button's visual design and color contrast
My page load is slow — optimize Core Web Vitals and reduce JavaScript bundle size
Should we use PostgreSQL or MongoDB for this microservice?
Create a logo and brand identity for our startup
